messages.content:
PLAN:
Now I have a thorough understanding of the codebase. Let me formulate the execution plan.

---

## Execution Plan

**Goal:** Create `src/engine/__tests__/advisorGeneralPalace.test.ts` — a comprehensive test suite verifying that the **advisor** (士/仕) and **general** (将/帅) pieces are strictly confined to their respective palaces.

### Context

- **Advisor** moves one step diagonally and must stay in the palace (`moveValidation.ts:153-167`, uses `ADVISOR_OFFSETS` + `isInPalace` check).
- **General** moves one step orthogonally and must stay in the palace (`moveValidation.ts:171-185`, uses `GENERAL_OFFSETS` + `isInPalace` check).
- **Palace definitions** (`constants.ts:7-8`):
  - Red: rows 7–9, cols 3–5
  - Black: rows 0–2, cols 3–5
- Test helper pattern: empty board → place piece → call `getRawMoves` → assert via `moveSet` (matching existing tests like `soldierMoves.test.ts`).

### Step 1: Create the test file

**File:** `src/engine/__tests__/advisorGeneralPalace.test.ts`

**Imports & helpers** (mirroring `soldierMoves.test.ts` style):
- `import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'`
- `import type { Board, Piece, Position } from '../types'`
- `import { getRawMoves } from '../moveValidation'`
- Helper functions: `emptyBoard()`, `place(board, row, col, piece)`, `moveSet(moves)`
- Piece factories: `redAdvisor`, `blackAdvisor`, `redGeneral`, `blackGeneral`, `redChariot` / `blackChariot` (for capture/own-piece blocking tests)

### Step 2: Advisor test cases (`describe('advisorPalaceBoundary', ...)`)

| # | Test case | Setup | Assertion |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------|
| 1 | **Red advisor at center of palace (8,4)** | Advisor on (8,4) | All 4 diagonal moves valid: (7,3), (7,5), (9,3), (9,5) — 4 moves |
| 2 | **Red advisor at corner of palace (7,3)** | Advisor on (7,3) | Only (8,4) valid; (6,2) is out of palace — 1 move |
| 3 | **Red advisor at corner (7,5)** | Advisor on (7,5) | Only (8,4) valid — 1 move |
| 4 | **Red advisor at corner (9,3)** | Advisor on (9,3) | Only (8,4) valid — 1 move |
| 5 | **Red advisor at corner (9,5)** | Advisor on (9,5) | Only (8,4) valid — 1 move |
| 6 | **Black advisor at center of palace (1,4)** | Advisor on (1,4) | All 4 diagonal moves valid: (0,3), (0,5), (2,3), (2,5) — 4 moves |
| 7 | **Black advisor at corner (0,3)** | Advisor on (0,3) | Only (1,4) valid — 1 move |
| 8 | **Black advisor at corner (0,5)** | Advisor on (0,5) | Only (1,4) valid — 1 move |
| 9 | **Black advisor at corner (2,3)** | Advisor on (2,3) | Only (1,4) valid — 1 move |
| 10 | **Black advisor at corner (2,5)** | Advisor on (2,5) | Only (1,4) valid — 1 move |
| 11 | **Advisor cannot move out of palace (col 2 / col 6)** | Red advisor at (8,3), check moves | No move has col < 3 or col > 5 |
| 12 | **Advisor can capture enemy piece inside palace** | Red advisor (8,4), black chariot (7,3) | (7,3) is in the move set |
| 13 | **Advisor cannot capture own piece** | Red advisor (8,4), red chariot (7,3) | (7,3) is NOT in the move set |
| 14 | **Advisor exhaustively scanned: never generates a move outside palace** | Red advisor at every palace position | Every generated move satisfies `isInPalace(move, 'red')` |
| 15 | Same for black advisor | Black advisor at every palace position | Every generated move satisfies `isInPalace(move, 'black')` |

### Step 3: General test cases (`describe('generalPalaceBoundary', ...)`)

| # | Test case | Setup | Assertion |
|---|-----------|-------|-----------|
| 1 | **Red general at center of palace (8,4)** | General on (8,4) | Orthogonal moves: (7,4), (9,4), (8,3), (8,5) — 4 moves |
| 2 | **Red general at palace edge (7,4)** | General on (7,4) | (6,4) is out of palace; valid: (8,4), (7,3), (7,5) — 3 moves |
| 3 | **Red general at (9,4)** | General on (9,4) | (10,4) out of bounds; valid: (8,4), (9,3), (9,5) — 3 moves |
| 4 | **Red general at (8,3)** | General on (8,3) | (8,2) out of palace; valid: (7,3), (9,3), (8,4) — 3 moves |
| 5 | **Red general at (8,5)** | General on (8,5) | (8,6) out of palace; valid: (7,5), (9,5), (8,4) — 3 moves |
| 6 | **Red general at corner (7,3)** | General on (7,3) | (6,3) and (7,2) out of palace; valid: (8,3), (7,4) — 2 moves |
| 7 | **Red general at corner (7,5)** | General on (7,5) | valid: (8,5), (7,4) — 2 moves |
| 8 | **Red general at corner (9,3)** | General on (9,3) | valid: (8,3), (9,4) — 2 moves |
| 9 | **Red general at corner (9,5)** | General on (9,5) | valid: (8,5), (9,4) — 2 moves |
| 10 | **Black general at center (1,4)** | General on (1,4) | (0,4), (2,4), (1,3), (1,5) — 4 moves |
| 11 | **Black general at edge (2,4)** | General on (2,4) | (3,4) out of palace; valid: (1,4), (2,3), (2,5) — 3 moves |
| 12 | **Black general at (0,4)** | General on (0,4) | (−1,4) out of bounds; valid: (1,4), (0,3), (0,5) — 3 moves |
| 13 | **Black general at corners (0,3), (0,5), (2,3), (2,5)** | Each corner | 2 moves each |
| 14 | **General can capture enemy piece inside palace** | Red general (8,4), black chariot (8,3) | (8,3) in move set |
| 15 | **General cannot capture own piece** | Red general (8,4), red chariot (8,3) | (8,3) NOT in move set |
| 16 | **General exhaustively scanned: never generates a move outside palace** | Red general at every palace position | Every move satisfies `isInPalace(move, 'red')` |
| 17 | Same for black general | Black general at every palace position | Every move satisfies `isInPalace(move, 'black')` |

### Step 4: Exhaustive boundary sweep (`describe('exhaustivePalaceBoundary', ...)`)

- For every position on the entire board (0–9 × 0–8), place an advisor/general and verify:
  - If the piece is **inside** its palace, `getRawMoves` returns only palace-internal moves.
  - If the piece is **outside** its palace (shouldn't happen in a real game, but engine should still constrain), `getRawMoves` returns empty (the `isInPalace` check on the *destination* still prevents any moves since no valid destination will be inside the palace from an outside starting position that doesn't border the palace — actually from just outside the palace the advisor/general could still target an inside-palace square. So this test should verify that **all generated destinations** are within the palace, regardless of starting position.)

### Step 5: Run tests and verify

- Execute `npx vitest run src/engine/__tests__/advisorGeneralPalace.test.ts`
- All tests should pass, confirming palace confinement is correctly enforced.

### Key design decisions
- Use `getRawMoves` (from `moveValidation.ts`) directly — this isolates the palace-confinement logic from check-detection / flying-general filtering, making the tests focused.
- Import `isInPalace` from `constants.ts` for the exhaustive assertions.
- Follow existing test patterns (helpers, factories, `moveSet`) from `soldierMoves.test.ts` for consistency.
